subject: Removal request: CH-401 prompt outputs, logs and confirmation templates
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cardeahealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security@cardeahealth.com
Date: 2025-11-05T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Removal request: CH-401 prompt outputs and logs

Hi Markus,

We need Redwood to remove all prompt outputs, associated transient artifacts (KV cache slices), and any diagnostic logs tied to tenant CH-401 as part of our decommission checklist. This is tied to a contract clause and our internal retention policy; requested completion window is 10 business days.

Attached is the signed Data Deletion Request (ch-401-deletion-request.pdf). Please confirm scope (prompt outputs, ephemeral caches, model telemetry, audit logs) and provide a mutual action plan with milestones and evidence delivery method. We will need a receipt email for our compliance team and a downloadable proof bundle (hashed manifest).

Can you also confirm whether any derived embeddings or third-party backups are included?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Operations
Cardea Health

Attachment: ch-401-deletion-request.pdf (application/pdf)
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cardeahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-05T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Removal request: CH-401 prompt outputs and logs

Elena — thanks for the request and the signed form. Quick ack: we can execute within your 10-business-day window but I want to nail scope so we avoid missed artifacts.

High-level proposed scope (please confirm):
- Prompt outputs (generated text stored in prompt-output logs)
- KV cache snapshots tied to CH-401 sessions
- Inference-level diagnostic logs (non-aggregated request traces)
- Audit events and operator notes for the CH-401 tenant

Open questions:
1) Do you require deletion of embeddings or any model fine-tune artifacts derived from CH-401 data?
2) Any jurisdictional constraints for proof delivery (e.g., must stay within EU)?

I've attached a draft runbook that maps actions to owners and rough ETA: removal-runbook-v1.docx. Proposed plan:
- Day 0: Intake + scope signoff
- Day 1–3: Snapshot & isolate artifacts (read-only)
- Day 4–7: Execute deletion across storage tiers, purge KV cache, retire relevant model checkpoints
- Day 8–9: Recompute proof manifest + generate hash bundle
- Day 10: Deliver proof bundle & confirmation email templates

Laura (OPS) and Marissa (Compliance) are cc'd to own execution and evidence.

Markus Klein
Director, Security & Platform Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachment: removal-runbook-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cardeahealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-06T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Removal request: CH-401 prompt outputs and logs

Hi Elena — looping in details and compliance notes.

Per Markus' runbook, ops will execute a two-pass deletion so we can provide cryptographic evidence:
- Pass 1: Logical deletion (metadata and access pointers removed) + KV cache eviction
- Pass 2: Storage-level sweep (object delete + zero-out where required)

Evidence delivery options:
- Secure S3 bucket with pre-signed, time-limited URLs (we can geo-restrict to EU region)
- Signed manifest file with SHA-256 checksums for each deleted artifact (proof_manifest.txt)
- Optional notarization: we can provide a PGP-signed manifest or transfer the manifest hash into our internal logchain (JIRA SEC-2197) and share the entry id.

Marissa: please confirm any billing/retention hold impacts before we schedule the sweep.

Elena — can you confirm that embeddings and derivative datasets should be included? If so, add a line in the signed form (we can accept an email confirmation for scope addition).

Laura Bennett
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proof_manifest.txt (text/plain)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cardeahealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-06T18:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Removal request: CH-401 prompt outputs and logs

Thanks Laura / Markus — we confirm: include embeddings and any derivative datasets produced for CH-401. Proof delivery should be EU-only hosting.

A couple of asks from our compliance team:
- Provide 2 sample confirmation emails we can send internally to stakeholders once deletion is complete (one short receipt for ops, one detailed proof summary for legal)
- Demonstrate a sample line from the manifest (filename + sha256 + deletion-timestamp) in the final bundle so our auditors can verify format

If you can deliver the confirmation-email templates as a doc and include a DocuSign link for the final acceptance form that would be perfect.

We'll be waiting on the runbook signoff and the DocuSign.

—Elena

On Nov 5, 2025, at 16:12, markus_klein@redwood.ai wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the request and the signed form. Quick ack: we can execute within your 10-business-day window but I want to nail scope so we avoid missed artifacts.
>
> High-level proposed scope (please confirm):
> - Prompt outputs (generated text stored in prompt-output logs)
> - KV cache snapshots tied to CH-401 sessions
> - Inference-level diagnostic logs (non-aggregated request traces)
> - Audit events and operator notes for the CH-401 tenant
>
> Open questions:
> 1) Do you require deletion of embeddings or any model fine-tune artifacts derived from CH-401 data?
> 2) Any jurisdictional constraints for proof delivery (e.g., must stay within EU)?

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cardeahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-07T09:57:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Removal request: CH-401 prompt outputs and logs

Elena — thanks for the confirmation. Finalizing runbook and evidence cadence below; please reply with a single-line signoff and we'll start Day 0 tomorrow.

Final scope (confirmed): prompt outputs, KV cache slices, inference diagnostic logs, audit events, embeddings and derivative datasets, backups and snapshots tied to CH-401.

Execution & evidence timeline (UTC converted):
- Day 0 (2025-11-08 UTC): Scope signoff and freeze window
- Day 1–3: Snapshot isolation & pre-delete manifest generation (read-only)
- Day 4–7: Deletion pass across storage tiers, KV eviction, checkpoint retirements
- Day 8: Manifest finalization + SHA-256 bundle generation
- Day 9: Upload proof bundle to EU-restricted S3 and PGP-sign the manifest
- Day 10: Delivery of both confirmation emails + optional DocuSign final acceptance link

Attached: confirmation-email-templates.docx — two templates included (Ops receipt, Compliance proof summary). DocuSign link will be generated when we start Day 0 and shared in that email.

Proof manifest example (line):
ch401/prompt-outputs/2024-07-11_13-22-07.log  e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4  2025-11-13T14:55:03Z

Marissa: please confirm there are no holds from Billing that would prevent lifecycle actions this week.

If no objections, please reply-all with a single-line signoff and we will proceed.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Platform Trust
Redwood Inference
